source_claim: Aizawa Ema's official YouTube channel published her debut stream and successive outfit-reveal streams. These first-party records establish the same Aizawa Ema identity across the initial appearance and the numbered subsequent costume appearances represented by the campaign's 1st through 5th costume tags.
notes: First-party official channel and records: debut/initial appearance https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SmL3GUMV04M; 2nd outfit reveal, titled 初めてのお衣装チェンジ (2022-07-24), https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=khF7WfDjoqI; 3rd outfit reveal, titled 約1年ぶりのお衣装チェンジ (2023-07-02), https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RbsnsVhJI7E; 4th outfit reveal (2024-08-04), https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yiy77GiWuqI; 5th outfit reveal (2025-06-01), https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lag_-cJTrf8. The agency's official profile confirms the base identity: https://vspo.jp/.
